title: The MADHYA PRADESH UPCHARYAGRIHA TATHA RAJOPCHAR SAMBANDI STHAPANAYE (RAGISTRIKARAN TATHA ANUGYAPAN) ADHINIYAM, 1973.
full_text: The MADHYA PRADESH UPCHARYAGRIHA TATHA RAJOPCHAR SAMBANDI STHAPANAYE (RAGISTRIKARAN TATHA ANUGYAPAN) ADHINIYAM, 1973. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act Number: 47 Enactment Date: 1973-11-19 Act Year: 1973 Short Title: The MADHYA PRADESH UPCHARYAGRIHA TATHA RAJOPCHAR SAMBANDI STHAPANAYE (RAGISTRIKARAN TATHA ANUGYAPAN) ADHINIYAM, 1973. Long Title: The Madhya Pradesh Nursing Homes Registration Act. 1954 (28 of 1954) is at present in force in this State. This contains provision for registration of nursing homes and for purpose connected herewith. It, however, does not contain provisions for registration of clinical establishment.
